Coverage_Description: Unauthorized-use protection for lost credit cards (up to 10 cards, HK$1,500 per card per loss; up to HK$1,000,000/year after reporting). Includes extra lost-card benefits when card and HKID are lost together, plus 24-hour emergency travel assistance (up to HK$20,000/year)
pricing: HK$500/year (annual premium); minimum non-refundable premium HK$300 per policy.
customer requirement: Applicant/policyholder must be Hong Kong resident; only Hong Kong-issued credit cards are covered
price structure: Fixed annual premium per policy; first HK$250 excess applies to each loss in Sections 1 and 2
additional informations: Can extend coverage to up to 4 immediate family members (spouse and unmarried children living with insured in Hong Kong)
